We are a group of researchers passionate about AI, predictive analytics, and large language models. 

## Join Us
We are currently looking for a fully funded Ph.D. student starting in Spring 2027, as well as motivated undergraduate researchers to join our lab. 

If you are interested in joining our team, please send an email to taoran.ji@tamucc.edu with:

1. Your updated CV
2. A brief note indicating which specific project(s) or research areas in our lab interest you

*Note: Due to the high volume of inquiries, we are unable to respond to every individual email, but all eligible applications will be reviewed.*
